name: cover_landmark
description: Move the bound body toward an observed landmark to establish spatial coverage.
conditions: Mobile body; landmark position available.

name: pursue_target
description: Move toward a locally observed evader or forager using the existing pursuit tracker; publish target evidence to reachable peers.
conditions: Mobile pursuer or leader; target locally observed.

name: follow_peer
description: Move toward the target position carried in a received peer target report.
conditions: Mobile participant; target-kind message received.

name: evade_peer
description: Move away from a locally observed pursuer or leader using the existing evasion tracker.
conditions: Mobile body; threatening participant locally observed.

name: return_in_bounds
description: Request motion toward the fixed origin waypoint (0,0,-5) through the local tracker.
conditions: Mobile body. The executor targets the origin, not the center of an arbitrary custom region.

name: signal_goal
description: Send the privately known goal identifier to task-reachable listeners.
conditions: Speaker has access to the private goal. The speaker remains stationary.

name: follow_signal
description: Move the listening body toward the goal referenced by a received goal message.
conditions: Mobile listener; a goal-kind message has been received.

name: encode_message
description: Transmit the private symbol XOR the shared key as ciphertext to the communication recipients.
conditions: Stationary sender has the private symbol and shared key.

name: decode_message
description: Submit a reconstruction of the hidden symbol from received ciphertext and the locally available key.
conditions: Stationary receiver has the shared key and received evidence.

name: guess_message
description: Submit a guess of the hidden symbol using the communication evidence available without the private key.
conditions: Stationary eavesdropper; no access to the shared private key.
aliases: infer a secret symbol without a key

name: take_formation_slot
description: Move toward the formation slot assigned to this body; slot geometry is supplied by the environment.
conditions: Mobile formation member; own slot is present.

name: signal_target
description: Send a locally observed target identifier and position to task-reachable peers while stopping this body's current motion.
conditions: Leader with locally visible target evidence.

name: seek_food
description: Move toward a visible food resource; arrival increments that resource's visit count.
conditions: Mobile forager; food locally observed.

name: seek_cover
description: Move toward a visible forest region where the environment restricts ordinary pursuer sensing.
conditions: Mobile forager; cover region locally observed.

name: collect_treasure
description: Move toward an available treasure and pick it up within the interaction radius when the body's cargo slot is empty.
conditions: Mobile collector; free cargo slot and visible uncollected treasure.

name: deliver_treasure
description: Move loaded cargo toward a matching-color mobile deposit participant; mark the treasure delivered within the interaction radius.
conditions: Collector carries cargo; compatible deposit is locally observed.

name: meet_collector
description: Move a mobile deposit body toward a collector carrying cargo of the deposit's matching color.
conditions: Mobile red or blue deposit; matching loaded collector locally observed.

name: approach_goal
description: Move toward the privately known goal landmark.
conditions: Informed participant has access to the private goal.

name: approach_decoy
description: Move toward a non-goal landmark that an informed participant can distinguish from the private goal.
conditions: Informed participant has access to the private goal and candidate landmarks.

name: infer_goal
description: Choose a public landmark as the inferred hidden goal and move toward it using local evidence.
conditions: Mobile adversary without private goal access; candidate landmark available.

name: explore_local
description: Move toward a locally generated exploratory waypoint using the existing body-local tracker.
conditions: Mobile participant.

name: hold_position
description: Stop this body's current commanded motion without controlling another participant.
conditions: Own-body execution scope.
